title: “This Is the Night” by Clay Aiken

title: “The Remedy (I Won't Worry)” by Jason Mraz
text: "The Remedy" is the debut single of American singer-songwriter Jason Mraz from his debut album, Waiting for My Rocket to Come (2002). Written by Mraz and production team the Matrix (Lauren Christy, Scott Spock, and Graham Edwards), the song is about a good friend of Mraz's, Charlie Mingroni, being struck with cancer and how it changed Mraz's outlook on life.
